AIRPORT ADVISORY COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, OCTOBER 15, 2026
  4700 AIRPORT PLAZA DRIVE
  LONG BEACH MARRIOTT, 4:00 PM

Mark Christoffels, Chair  Katie Larson, Commissioner
Ryan Gales, Vice Chair  John Mosquera, Commissioner
Phyllis Arias, Commissioner  Marva Thomas, Commissioner
Kenneth Brown, Commissioner  Randy Zarn, Commissioner

  Members of the public have the option to email public comments to

  lgbarpt@longbeach.gov

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  26-56265  Recommendation to approve the minutes from the meeting of the Airport Advisory
  Commission on September 17, 2026.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  26-56266  Recommendation to receive and file presentation regarding the LGB Business
  Partner Spotlight, featuring Daniel Medina, Atlantic Aviation General Manager.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  26-56267  Recommendation to establish an Ad-Hoc Committee to determine whether to
  further present on general aviation landing fees pursuant to Council District 5’s
  May 13, 2026 request, with such Committee terminating on November 18, 2026,
  after reporting back to the Commission on said date.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  26-56395  Recommendation to receive and file report from the Sustainability Committee,
  regarding Airport sustainability efforts with air quality, energy conservation, water
  quality, and waste management.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  26-56268  Recommendation to receive and file Monthly Airport Staff Reports for October
  2026.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

   AIRPORT ADVISORY COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, OCTOBER 15, 2026
  4700 AIRPORT PLAZA DRIVE
  LONG BEACH MARRIOTT, 4:00 PM

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Airport Advisory Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is
limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Valeria Garcia, Secretary, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours prior to the
meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the Americans
with Disabilities Act, please contact Long Beach Airport at (562) 570-2619 or
LGBarpt@longbeach.gov.
